description: This Java class defines a REST endpoint for performing health checks, providing status information via an HTTP GET request at '/health'. It uses Spring Framework annotations and dependencies to inject a health check service and returns a status resource based on the health check results.

classes.name: HealthCheckRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller providing a health check endpoint at '/health'. It retrieves health status from a injected health check service, constructs a status resource, and responds with an HTTP 200 OK containing the status.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/health', retrieves current health status, creates a status resource, and returns it in an HTTP response.
